item.title: Author Post
item.content:encoded:
I'm a little afraid for this one. Not a lot, I think it will stand up, of course, but I'm afraid that it's not the best it could have been because I wrote the last… thousand words? Out of the 5,000 words, that is. I wrote the last fifth of this while really, really sick. Had some people look over and say "looks good!" but still. Anyways, two more chapters!! Exciting!! Thanks once again to DrChandra for helping me get Manny and Icky's lines to feel like Manny and Icky. I did write all the lines this time, but Chandra gave me a lot of pointers so it didn't feel… bad. So, thank you.

Thankfully for me, I never have to write Icky and Manny again. I'm glad to have had the experience of writing someone else's character, but man, it is hard.

EDIT: Added a piece to the end that I forgot was very important.
